import os,json
from pathlib import Path
os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE","core.settings")
import django
django.setup()
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import connection,transaction
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.data_center.infrastructure.models import ProviderConfigModel,DataProviderSettingsModel
with transaction.atomic():
 with connection.cursor() as c:
  c.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
  c.execute("SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'")
 manifest=json.loads(Path(settings.AGOM_RELEASE_MANIFEST_PATH).read_text())
 if manifest.get("source_commit")!="0e9f890e8185d897630fd937b5ffc220fd7830ce" or manifest.get("release_tag")!="20260907170119":raise RuntimeError("candidate drift")
 providers=[]
 for p in ProviderConfigModel.objects.order_by("priority","name"):
  providers.append({"id":p.pk,"name":p.name,"source_type":p.source_type,"is_active":p.is_active,"priority":p.priority,"has_http_url":bool(p.http_url),"has_api_endpoint":bool(p.api_endpoint),"extra_config_keys":sorted(p.extra_config) if isinstance(p.extra_config,dict) else None})
 print(json.dumps({"recorded_at":timezone.now().isoformat(),"source_commit":manifest["source_commit"],"release_tag":manifest["release_tag"],"providers":providers,"settings":list(DataProviderSettingsModel.objects.order_by("id").values("id","default_source","enable_failover","failover_tolerance")),"read_only":True}))

interpretation: Configured source preference and failover tolerance are real inputs; dataset-specific acceptance applicability still requires code/contract verification. No provider request, credential read, configuration mutation or publication switch.
